entries.appliesTo: New Jersey Economic Development Authority tax-credit allocations under the Next New Jersey Program Act

params.scope: halves Next New Jersey Program (AI/data-center investment) tax-credit set-aside from $500M to $250M

sources.scope: § 1 (amending § 98(b)(1)(k) of P.L.2020, c.156, C.34:1B-362) — 'an amount not to exceed [$500,000,000] $250,000,000 shall be made available for projects awarded a tax credit pursuant to the "Next New Jersey Program Act," P.L.2024, c.49 (C.34:1B-394 et al.)'

flags: reprint-deletions: all superscript-1 bracketed matter was struck by the June 24, 2026 Senate Budget and Appropriations Committee amendments — the energy-storage tax-credit program (§§ 4-5), the $100 ratepayer gross-income-tax credit (§ 6), rulemaking (§ 7), and the P.L.2025, c.136 amendments (§§ 2-3) are all deleted; only the § 1 cap reduction and the effective-date clause remain operative

no-compliance-duty: bill imposes no obligation on any private or public actor beyond reallocating an incentive cap; there are no duty-hour-generating requirements — cost impact is forgone tax credits, not compliance work

ai-nexus-indirect: the enacted text never uses the words 'artificial intelligence' or 'data center' outside the act's designation ('designated as the "End Data Center Tax Credits Act"'); the AI/data-center connection runs through the cross-referenced Next New Jersey Program Act, P.L.2024, c.49, which this text does not describe
category-fit: no CODING.md category cleanly fits a tax-credit reallocation; coded public-sector because the only entity whose behavior the text constrains is the state authority administering the cap
